title: Electrolysis Basics
ques: When electric current is passed through water (which has a little acid mixed in), the water molecules break apart into two different gases. Name the two gases produced.

answer.content: The two gases produced are **Hydrogen** and **Oxygen**.

explanation: This exercise tests knowledge of one of the most fundamental electrolytic reactions.

title: Electroplating Process
ques: In a factory, an iron car bumper is coated with a thin layer of shiny chromium metal using electricity. What is this industrial process called, and why is it done?

answer.content: This process is called **Electroplating**. It is done for two main reasons: to make the bumper look shiny and attractive, and to protect the iron underneath from rusting and corrosion.

explanation: This links abstract electrochemistry to a major real-world industrial application.

title: Chemical Effects Overview
ques: List two signs that indicate a chemical effect is taking place when an electric current passes through a conducting solution.

answer.content:
Signs of a chemical effect include:
1. The formation of **gas bubbles** at the electrodes.
2. A change in the **color** of the solution.
3. The deposit of metal on one of the electrodes.

explanation: This requires identifying observational evidence of electrochemical reactions.
